hops.selected_change: GEMINI_API_KEY sessions stop on daily quota, spend-cap, or prepaid-credit exhaustion instead of retrying those cases; short rate limits continue to retry.
hops.remaining_proof: EnvironmentRef is opaque and the approved profile has no credential reference; this does not prove GEMINI_API_KEY is absent from the child environment.

hops.selected_change: Model API retry delay and quota handling changes: waits the server delay and stops rather than retrying when it exceeds 30 seconds or is a daily/billing cap.
hops.remaining_proof: The exact AGY_CLI_MODEL_API_MAX_RETRIES=0 semantics are proven for 1.2.11 only; later artifact semantics are not established.

hops.selected_change: --json-schema now rejects non-object roots and unsupported or missing schema inputs at startup.
hops.remaining_proof: The adapter validates object-root schemas and passes inline JSON; no new schema form or operation is selected. Preserve the existing schema regression coverage.

hops.selected_change: An unapproved permission request is respected and no alternate command, script, or tool workaround is attempted.
hops.remaining_proof: The official guide documents exit 0 and an stderr notice when the run continues after soft denial. Document that run completion does not prove each requested tool executed; leave typed denial unclaimed and do not parse unspecified stderr.

hops.selected_change: Headless -p now waits for a background command that finishes after the first turn; image generation is handed to a subagent.
hops.remaining_proof: The adapter drains stdout through EOF and then waits for the process. When child identities have no child status, preserve identity with SubagentStatus::Unknown; do not infer child completion from the enclosing step or outer result.

hops.selected_change: The Windows command sandbox no longer needs administrator rights and gains common tool support.
hops.remaining_proof: Windows --sandbox runtime proof is deferred to the windows-compatibility lane. This task makes no Windows claim or support change.

hops.remaining_proof: Research 401 maps project-path and custom-agent discovery into the Mac ARM64 selected headless path, but does not connect resource values through backend RPC to a selected tool or permission decision. No behavior or capability expansion is inferred.

hops.selected_change: Custom-agent relative paths change; subagents that stop on error now show Error in /agents and the running-agent list; GEMINI_API_KEY turns retry dropped connections.
hops.remaining_proof: Research 401 maps loadMDAgent and relative-resource resolution on Mac ARM64. Retry-budget, resource-to-tool flow, and approved-environment auth effects remain unproven.
